property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference C reverts when given an empty _tos array (_tos.length == 0), but the mutant allows empty arrays and thus will not revert for some inputs where the reference reverts.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length >= 0 (always true), so transfer proceeds even with empty _tos and returns true instead of reverting for that input.
